source: Polymarket Gamma API (gamma-api.polymarket.com; best bid/ask per market)
rule: BETS PAUSED: no outcome is recommended while the model trails the market on settled matches. Candidate rule (would_qualify) = highest EV per $1 among outcomes with model prob > 50% AND edge > 0 (edge = model prob - ask incl. the Polymarket taker fee rate*p*(1-p)); otherwise NO BET
note: Prices are compared with forecasts frozen BEFORE the snapshot; they are never model inputs.
